message.content: During the 19th‑century, one of the most celebrated works of sculpture was **“The Kiss” (Le Baiser) by Auguste Rodin**. Completed between 1888 and 1891, this bronze masterpiece captured the public imagination with its sensual realism and dramatic use of form. It quickly became emblematic of the era’s shift toward expressive, emotionally charged art, and remains one of the most recognizable sculptures worldwide.
